genealogy: Underlying1648 public-domain original, BBHL/Botanical Library scan. CC BY4 applies to independently authored Arca transcription/curation. It does not establish Maranhão alone or a modern precise lect. DeLaet annotations/shared older witnesses are not independent corroboration of later wrappers. Explicit selected dictionary pairs only; kinship qualifications and uncertain paleographic items are deferred, not silently generalized. No source-specific IPA/profile inferred.
